causal_clock.entry: first 5-minute open strictly after completed signal hour
causal_clock.regime_threshold: cell Q60 or Q75 of preceding 756 finite RV20 observations strictly before t
causal_clock.rv20: sqrt(365*mean(r_d^2)) using calendar-day returns t-20 through t-1

contamination.claim: contamination-aware discovery; no pristine OOS claim
contamination.design_evidence: prior strict Q90 flush was too sparse; Q80/Q90 participation continuation had weak pre-2024 ratio and only 12 active weeks

features.oi_change_1h: log(last completed-hour OI / prior completed-hour OI)
features.threshold_clock: preceding 2160 finite completed-hour observations shifted one hour; linear interpolation

frozen_grid.side_rule: down shock+taker_fraction<=cap+OI change<=quantile enters long; up shock+taker_fraction>=1-cap+OI change<=quantile enters short

mechanism: During a causally known above-normal volatility regime, a completed one-hour directional overextension with extreme same-direction taker flow but below-typical open-interest change is more consistent with position transfer/liquidation than durable new participation; reverse at the next 5-minute open.

path_accounting.barrier_order: gap at bar open; otherwise adverse before favorable
path_accounting.non_overlap: one position maximum; independently flat evaluation windows

persistent_long_vol_control.definition: long BTC at identical candidate gross from first 5m open of every active selected-regime day to final close
persistent_long_vol_control.gate: normal and stress candidate-minus-control log return positive in train, 2024, each future, combined future

selection.future: single frozen top1/weight only; no rerank, repair, rank2, threshold change
selection.leverage_selection: highest pre-2024 CAGR subject to strict MDD<=15%, CAGR/MDD>=3, positive 10bp stress
selection.weight_selection: 2024 only; maximize same-gross CAGR/MDD improvement subject to no MDD worsening and max exact-entry Jaccard<=0.15
